stories.title: Wuppertal: Festnahme nach Brandanschlag auf Synagoge

en.title: Wuppertal: Arrest after arson attack on synagogue
en.summary: A fire was set at a synagogue in Wuppertal, Germany, and police arrested a suspect. No injuries were reported in the attack, and Jewish leaders expressed serious concern.

en.title: Antisemitism: Arson attack on synagogue in Wuppertal
en.summary: Fire was deliberately set at a synagogue in Wuppertal and police detained a suspect. Jewish community leaders are calling for increased security measures during the Jewish holiday.

en.summary: A malaria patient has died in Frankfurt am Main. Both this person and another infected individual lived near the airport and had not traveled to malaria-endemic regions.
